text:
Jamie: Starting tri-region rollout now — US -> EU -> APAC. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-21 (minor model update + batching tweak). Change window 03:00-05:00 UTC. Can ops-sre confirm warm pools?
Ravi: Quick check — what are our target QPS slices per region for this slice?
Maria: Also please pin EU to v2.3.1 if APAC doesn't meet warmup, we don't want cross-region degradation.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: initiating deploy slice 1 -> US (version v2.4.0). Canary size: 5% per-route. Command: `deploy start --slice=us --ver=v2.4.0 --canary=5`
ops-sre: US warm pool ok: 120 GPUs reserved (80% utilization cushion). EU warm pool at 70 GPUs (we're at 65% cushion). APAC warm pool currently 18 GPUs (below requested 40).
Leila: APAC short by ~22 GPUs, likely warmup delay ~8-12m. Is burst capacity allowed during this window?
Nick: If APAC <40 we should pin APAC traffic to v2.3.1 and route to EU fallback for enterprise tenants for the next 30m. Low risk.
Ravi: Outcome options: 1) proceed and accept degraded APAC latency, 2) pin APAC, continue US/EU, 3) delay full rollout until APAC warm. Ops-sre — what's your recommendation?
ops-sre: Recommend option 2. EU can absorb ~12% additional traffic with current warm pool; US unaffected. APAC needs warm pool fill before model variant swap.
Maria: agree option 2. Also add a rollback signal: if error rate per-route >2.5% sustained for 5m in EU after ramp, rollback to v2.3.1.
Jamie: ok. Plan: 1) deploy US canary now (deploy-bot kicked), 2) continue to EU canary in 5m, 3) hold APAC and pin to v2.3.1 until warm pool >=40.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: US canary success — 5% traffic, latency +5ms median, error rate 0.2%. Logs: ```[1748001170] canary/us: ok
[1748001175] metrics: p50=45ms p95=120ms errors=0.2%```
Leila: EU canary scheduled in 5m. Ops-sre, please start APAC warmup job and attach progress here.
ops-sre: starting APAC warmup: `infra warmup --region=apac --target-gpus=40 --priority=burst` — ETA ~10m. Will post updates.
Ravi: tagging @deploy-bot to pin APAC routes to v2.3.1 until cleared.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pin applied to APAC routing -> v2.3.1 (routes: enterprise-*, search-*, embeddings-*).
ops-sre: APAC warmup update t+4m: 18 -> 28 GPUs, provisioning slowed by image pull rate limits on one rack.
Nick: can we move some EU idle capacity temporarily to APAC via region-shift? Any legal/network constraints?
ops-sre: cross-region pulling not feasible for private tenants; public customers can be routed to EU fallback. We'll open a ticket for image caching to speed pulls.
Maria: please update release notes with the hold decision and the rollback trigger. I added a small blurb in the doc.
Jamie: EU canary started. deploy-bot, post canary metrics when ready.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: EU canary 5% live -> p50=48ms p95=130ms errors=0.4% (within thresholds).
Ravi: Good. Proceed EU -> ramp to 25% over 10m, monitor; US ramping to 25% as well. APAC remains pinned.
ops-sre: APAC warmup t+9m: 28 -> 38 GPUs, hitting 38/40. Image cache tx completed on 1 rack, final nodes provisioning now.
Leila: hold until >=40, then we'll run quick smoke & then unpin. Who will run APAC smoke?
Nick: I'll run smoke tests (latency + correctness prompts) as soon as ops-sre signals green.
ops-sre: APAC warmup t+12m: reached 41 GPUs. Ready for smoke.
Nick: smoke started. Quick note: run prompt set 'apac-smoke-v1' and check embed consistency.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: unpin APAC routing -> scheduled v2.4.0 canary (5%). Command: `deploy start --slice=apac --ver=v2.4.0 --canary=5`
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: APAC canary started.
ops-sre: APAC canary metrics pending.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: APAC canary logs: ```[1748001490] canary/apac: p50=70ms p95=210ms errors=1.1%```
Maria: errors 1.1% ok under 2.5% threshold. Monitor for 5m. If >2.5% -> rollback.
Jamie: agreed. If APAC stable for 10m we'll proceed to full ramp. For now US/EU ramping to 50% then 100% per schedule.
Ravi: I'll update the release channel with the hold/pin decision + link to this thread.
Leila: noted. Action items: ops-sre follow up on image-cache ticket, Nick to finish smoke, Maria to update notes, Ravi to publish rollback checklist.
Jamie: thanks all. tagging :thumbsup: — closing this thread once EU/US hit 50% ramp and APAC stable for 10m.
